events.title: v1.0.0 A loopback Responses adapter
events.detail: The first release: a portable loopback Responses compatibility adapter with a watchdog, platform service adapters, bounded upstream retries and SSE reconnect handling.

events.title: v1.0.12 A retryable 503 after bounded recovery
events.detail: Once the pair-safe fallbacks are rejected, one final request carries only the latest instruction and the latest user request. Exhausted recovery and an exhausted DMXAPI 477 retry return a retryable 503 with Retry-After.

events.title: v1.0.43 One provider-portable grammar
events.detail: Every Responses replay request is projected onto a provider-portable grammar without changing Codex conversation storage. DMXAPI, UCloud/Azure and AIHubMix get fixed, isolated loopback routes.

events.title: v2.0.2 Codex Responses Proxy and a provider manifest
events.detail: Renamed from the DMX-specific Codex DMX Proxy, it serves ordinary Responses endpoints through a provider manifest. Every request names an explicit /<provider>/v1 namespace, and installation no longer reads or rewrites Codex or AIGW configuration.

events.title: v3.1.16 Upgrades keep admitting requests
events.detail: A capability-qualified upgrade or rollback handoff no longer rejects new and in-flight Responses requests with proxy_draining. Bounded draining remains only for replacing a legacy native generation.

events.title: v4.0.0 Upgrades need generations
events.detail: In-place upgrades require a durable generation-based installation; an older flat one must be uninstalled before a fresh install. Linux requires a reachable user service manager and keeps the host's lingering policy.

events.title: v5.0.0 OpenAI Responses Proxy
events.detail: The product, command, native service and release assets take the new name; existing installations migrate by uninstall and fresh installation. --upstream-base-url selects one ordinary Responses upstream at installation.

events.title: v5.0.3 The macOS watchdog returns after a restart
events.detail: With a GUI login, installation registers the watchdog in that login's domain, which launchd reloads at every GUI login. Background-only registrations from 5.0.1 and 5.0.2 are migrated.

events.title: v5.1.0 Body admission and one exchange deadline
events.detail: A Responses body needs one ASCII Content-Length, at most 64 MiB, received within 30 s; transfer encodings and missing or repeated lengths get 400. The upstream timeout becomes one deadline per exchange.

events.title: v5.1.3 Upstream redirects are not followed
events.detail: A redirect could carry the client's Authorization header to another host; the client now receives the redirect itself. Drain and handoff controls accept only a loopback caller that sends no Origin.

events.title: v5.1.7 A completely sent request is never resent
events.detail: 5.1.6 retried every transport failure, which can duplicate provider work and billing. The client now receives 502 upstream_outcome_unknown; failures before the request is complete are still retried.

events.title: v5.1.10 Input too long, media over budget
events.detail: An upstream input-length or media-budget rejection gets one attempt with less history when the current input permits. Current user and tool images, instructions and tool dependencies are kept.
